g.text: More patience: 4,000 steps gave WAPE 44.92 vs 45.15 at 1,000, but bias -3.4% → -5.4%
N-HiTS, Huber δ5, 30,490 M5 weekly series, single seed. One setting changes per panel; every run uses the same
learning-rate schedule (one-cycle over 10,000 steps, no minimum-steps guard). Blue dot = base (1,000-step window, 13-week
validation, check every 50 steps, best weights restored); shaded band = base ± seed noise (0.2 WAPE).
